visual_logic: Isolates a single lateral 'grand blade' tooth to showcase the extreme lateral compression and serration profile characteristic of carcharodontosaurids.
prompt: High-fidelity 3D asset of a single fossilized large lateral blade tooth from a Carcharodontosaurus, rendered in a 3D animated feature film aesthetic with soft, stylized, and slightly rounded edges. The specimen exhibits a distinct 'grand blade' morphology: it is broad, significantly flattened (laterally compressed), and features sharp, prominent serrations (denticles) running along both the mesial and distal edges. The fossil texture is a weathered ivory/tan with matte finish, showing mineralization detail. The single tooth is vertically oriented and perfectly centered within a 1:1 square canvas, scaled meticulously to maintain a strict 25% empty background framing buffer on all four sides to prevent UI clipping. Set against a seamless, solid light-grey studio floor plane that extends completely across the entire canvas with no internal borders or boxes, featuring soft ambient occlusion and a small contact shadow cast directly underneath. A clean checkered black-and-white scientific scale bar sits centered at the bottom.
